sources.title: Improve drawn-curve fairing, overscan drawing, and geometry/control ranges
sources.description:
## Unified ROYGBIV control pass

Implements all eight requested changes directly in the existing generator:

1. **Flowier freehand paths:** arc-length resampling, stronger Gaussian fairing, and centripetal Catmull–Rom curve interpolation; Smooth remains separate from regularized Geometric.
2. **Start outside the frame:** temporary pointer capture spans the full preview stage, with off-frame normalized coordinates retained in recipes and clipped only during rendering. Works with zoom.
3. **Zoom out from first render:** mobile preview now ranges from 50% to 250% in 10% increments; default 100% retained.
4. **Nudges halved:** nudge buttons change positioning 1% instead of 2%.
5. **More spacing and thicker stripes:** broader independent spread/width mappings using the existing sliders.
6. **Much wider chevron scales:** broader shape frequency/depth and independent chevron motif size/repetition control through the existing shape sliders.
7. **Hairpin turn angle:** contextual 60°–180° slider next to turn radius; the exit stem remains tangent to the curved turn.
8. **All swipe-card sliders get −/+ controls:** unhides and compacts the existing reusable stepper controls; no duplicate components or vertical scrolling.

## Verification
- 119 automated Node tests pass, including new shape range, smoothing, off-canvas path and angular-hairpin checks.
- Chromium mobile acceptance passes for responsive cards, actual −/+ click behavior, zoom out from initial render, 1% nudges and zoom-safe touch drawing.
- Chromium desktop acceptance passes actual outside-frame mouse press and drawing into the image, storing a negative normalized point.
- Headless PNG smoke generates 18 actual images including the angled hairpin, expanded chevron/stripe controls and off-frame custom path; PNG recipe metadata round-trips.
- Visual inspection of the generated images completed. No new modes, galleries or special prioritization of the original seven references.

sources.title: Redesign the wallpaper editor around six creative categories and granular exploration
sources.description:
## Exploration-first editor redesign

The four historical category tabs have been replaced by **six clear editing intentions**: Layout, Path, Stripes, Colour, Material and Effects. Each category exposes directly selectable named tools, with native controls for every existing setting. Tap to jump to a tool, optionally swipe between adjacent tools. All 63 existing named controls have one canonical home via src/editor-schema.js; their same lock, inactive-state, number stepper, renderer and recipe implementations are reused. A search shortcut jumps to matching tools.

### Scoped exploration
- Global Random remains the dominant experience, respecting locks.
- **Reroll** or **Vary nearby** an individual setting, a named tool, or a category, each with Gentle / Moderate / Wild variation strength.
- Scoped changes preserve seeds, saved crop/zoom, unrelated settings, locks and hand-drawn path identities. New styles populate real editable values; the hidden Visual Family stripe-width multiplier is removed.
- **Recent variations** thumbnail strip lets users compare and restore alternatives without destroying Undo.
- Texture layers have separate Material/Finish named tools rather than three duplicated sequences of full-size cards.
- Wizard Mode is architecturally prepared by a shared six-step schema; no separate or mandatory wizard was introduced.

### Preview-first responsive navigation
- Editor occupies reserved space beneath the wallpaper; it never overlays the image, and workspace fit does not change saved artwork camera.
- Every one of the 7 stripes remains visible while editing. All active controls in all named tools fit without vertical scrolling, verified by an actual Chromium per-tool bounding-box audit.
- Removed the obsolete swipe-card JS and stylesheets, consolidating the responsive editor on one system. Existing zoom/nudge, PNG export, custom drawing, favourites, metadata and headless rendering preserved.

### Acceptance
- Exact PR head: **133/133 Node tests passing**.
- Actual mobile Chrome acceptance passed, including six-category navigation, direct named tools, per-setting scope purity, locks, category and tool rerolls, near variations, presets, enabled material layers, all-tool clipping audit, history restoration, preview separation and desktop recovery.
- Headless-render PNG smoke passed, including the full 3024 × 6552 export and recipe/metadata checks.
- Existing user workflows remain accessible while their old disorganized settings tabs have been intentionally retired.

sources.title: Fix drawn-path knot spikes and crossing endcap artifacts
sources.description:
## Fix for the reported wallpaper

The *exact* 96-point recipe from the screenshot (seed `t0b4v5-ice7lf`) is now checked in at `tests/fixtures/drawn-knot-t0b4v5.json` and rendered by the real mobile browser and headless PNG workflows.

### Corrected root causes
- **Curvature safety:** Previous 25th-percentile bend radius ignored the short sharp turns that made inward ribbons fold and sprout spurs. Compute smoothed multi-vertex curvature and preserve extra clearance around the tightest sustained bends. The reproducible recipe's seven-band spread is now **72.38 design pixels** in coherent mode. Turning safety off still permits extreme offset art.
- **Drawn-path normals:** The old ±0.15px finite-difference tangent snapped almost instantaneously at polyline knots. The new symmetric ±9px tangent is stable without changing the stored artist-drawn centreline.
- **Crossing repair:** Prevent local overpass rendering from restarting the original endpoint taper or drawing closed artificial transversal outline caps; repaint only the two open local outline edges.

### Acceptance
- All standard model/Node tests pass, including the exact 96-point geometry regression and the more conservative tight-turn test.
- Real Chromium mobile acceptance passes and confirms the full original recipe is still drawn, with three crossing modes passing their established visual-distinctness tests.
- Headless production PNG rendering of the same fixture passes, including embedded-recipe roundtrip.
- All three checks green on exact PR head `a16e16f97c33fba25f80cc1de54027c33b140949`.

Retains existing settings and saved recipe formats.

sources.title: QA: real mobile Drawn anchor finger drag versus overlapping tangents
sources.description:
Independently falsify a consequential drawing precision concern in #365. After tapping a saved authored interior anchor, the draw overlay prioritizes *tangent handles* over anchors within the same 17px radius. On a narrow phone a tangent can sit fewer than 17 visible CSS px from the selected anchor centre, so attempting to drag the square may deform its tangent instead. This source-only diagnostic reproduces selection and drags via genuine Chromium CDP `Input.dispatchTouchEvent` at 320/412px cream/dark, asserts moved anchor position, separately drags the computed outgoing tangent with unchanged anchor centre, and verifies **full real Apply → global Undo** for both transactions, no camera/recipe contamination and screenshots.

**Red-first draft:** do not merge on failed source drag. If reproducible, repair hit priority narrowly in the owning Draw module (prefer an exact anchor-centre touch over nearby tangent handle), retaining access to handles outside the anchor core. Re-run dedicated CI and unrelated Draw/Undo/precision gates. Do not claim physical thumb accuracy or crowded-geometry acceptance.

sources.title: Make Android ROYGBIV launcher icon full-bleed and maskable
sources.description:

Keep all current ordinary icons and website branding unchanged, and add a **dedicated full-bleed, opaque dark maskable 512×512 SVG** in the original seven-stroke ROYGBIV phone design. Declare `purpose: maskable` in the PWA manifest, enabling Chrome on Android to crop the dark background to its launcher circle/squircle rather than padding a small black tile on white. Original white phone and seven coloured capsules are centred within the standard 80%-diameter adaptive safe zone, proven by an automated Node test. This intentionally uses Chrome-supported SVG with existing 512 PNG `any` fallback; no change to generation, studio UI, splash, favicon or recipe.

Require exact-head Node/check and existing browser/manifest gates. **Physical Android refresh and visual approval remain unperformed**; Chrome/Android may cache installed WebAPK icon, so after deploying this updated manifest, remove the old ROYGBIV launcher installation and reinstall from Chrome if it does not refresh. Different Android launcher masks may visually vary.

sources.title: Replace tiled textures with seeded world-space materials and shared displacement
sources.description:
## Summary
Replace short repeated texture tiles with coordinate-anchored, seed-specific material painting, and drive stripe-edge displacement from the exact same spatial material field.

## Improvements
- Unique world-space flecks, fibres, fibres with interruptions, worn threads, irregular watercolor blooms, stone/concrete patches, wood grain, knit stitches and metallic creases: no `CanvasPattern` repetition at a small fixed interval.
- Material-specific continuous anisotropic height fields. Rendered surface detail and geometric contour relief use matching material-space samples, with scale, rotation, construction transforms, and layer coverage respected.
- Fix texture strength cancellation: each enabled stripe texture contributes proportionally, with multi-layer additions and a bounded stripe-width safeguard. With no active stripe material, Texture Displacement now produces no silent fallback grain.
- Seed and layer variation remain deterministic, ensuring saved recipes, links and PNG exports reproduce the same material. World-space crop, zoom and pan no longer reroll the material or change thread colour.
- Stable logical-space rasterization maintains worker/DOM pixel fidelity. View-framing overhang includes off-crop stains/fibres so seams do not appear at camera boundaries.
- New tests for material identity/seed uniqueness, displacement/strength/scale/rotation, non-tiling, additive layers, crop/worker parity for linen, watercolour and wood; documented contract and manual acceptance in `docs/MATERIAL-SURFACE-ENGINE-2026-10-21.md`.

## Validation
All **13 applicable checks on head `0bb383a9ffd98bb73090f2f9aa6d2ebb2bb55f54` passed**, including Validate Wallgen, Headless render smoke, real Chromium mobile smoke and worker parity, foreground pixel checks, native PNG export and metadata round-trip, and the six jobs in the 22-mode export matrix.

## Remaining human QA
Subjective aesthetic approval of all 21 finishes and Pixel 6 Pro physical latency/performance have not been performed. Functional browser tests and native export coverage are green; those claims must not be conflated with a human photographic-realism judgement.

## Colour Vision Preview (draft awaiting native-device / final visual acceptance)

**Full scientific, visual/UX and integration plan:** [docs/COLOUR-VISION-PREVIEW-PLAN.md](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/blob/feature/colour-vision-preview/docs/COLOUR-VISION-PREVIEW-PLAN.md).

Partial tritan anomaly is explicitly described as approximate. Anomaly versus anopia names and *Simulation strength* correctly avoid diagnosis claims.
- Live wallpaper **display-only overlay**, original Canvas2D renderer and full-resolution recipe/PNG export unchanged; independent worker, latest-frame invalidation and time-sliced no-worker fallback.

- Public-domain/MIT attributions retained; no runtime dependency or network requirement; optional `npm run bench:vision` for Node CPU measurements only.
- Latest `main` terminology work merged **into this feature branch only** at [6f3f5ce](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/commit/6f3f5ce0a238df05e9014b87543729d1e932353e). Main remains untouched by this PR.

### Verified CI evidence (source-bound)
- [Real Chromium 39732011513](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/39732011513): **1,486 sampled RGB points matched latest newly rendered wallpaper with max error 0** after background switched during simulation. 70%-strength model against per-pixel reference passed.
- Same run: simulated ON versus OFF generated actual **byte-identical 160×346 PNG** with matching SHA-256 `8b9bd7c88d29048a866767370369cc4d8773ed07b0c6381356fb6c574991baf3` and 67,818 bytes. This is export-path isolation, not a full-res memory benchmark.
- Same run: forced worker failure recovered through incremental compatibility conversion; original bitmap and URL preserved; desktop panel reparent and Escape restored focus.
- [Mobile acceptance 39732428987](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/39732428987): actual 320×700, 412×892, 700×412 button centres were hit; touch slider moved to targeted 74%; no horizontal overflow. Included open-More and unobstructed Studio screenshots in [artifact 12406410706](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/39732428987/artifacts/12406410706), both directly inspected.
- [Node validation 39732011692](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/39732011692) green; [Material Finish 39732011636](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/39732011636) green after main integration.

### Remaining, transparently unclaimed
Real Pixel 6 Pro touch/optical review, OS screen reader output, representative lower-power memory/performance p95, and any separate human approval for aesthetic choices. `npm run bench:vision` provides repeatable CPU instrumentation but cannot replace physical-device evidence. The PR remains **draft** until final acceptance. No claims that simulations exactly reproduce an individual's vision.

All scope-limited verification, outstanding gates and adoption guidance are documented in the plan.

sources.title: experiment(#557): bounded EDT topology diagnostics and real-image VTracer oracle
sources.description:
## Verified engineering implementation for issue #557

This PR adds bounded exact Euclidean distance-to-seeds, exterior-aware ink half-width, foreground/background topology, silhouette IoU/Dice and symmetric edge Chamfer as **diagnostic-only helpers**. No changes to editor UI, forward painter, source importer, canonical scene, or reconstruction ranking.

The independent, opt-in VTracer 1.0.0-alpha.4 experiment hashes original source PNGs before/after tracing, ignores original truth recipe sidecars, rasterizes VTracer output in real Chromium, compares with the same current RGB/ink fit metric, and produces source/canonical/vector comparison PNGs, SVGs, JSON and HTML. Tiny Node tests join quick CI; heavyweight workflow was returned to **manual-only** after real GHA proof.

### Verified real evidence

[Successful five-source GHA R0 optical proof](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40167263389): eight new deterministic mathematical/driver tests passed, and actual downloaded source/current/VTracer image triplets were directly inspected.

| Source | Canonical error | VTracer error | SVG paths |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| #05 Hairpin | .08447791 | .02005739 | 16 |
| #06 Loop | .04977317 | .02404494 | 107 |
| #16 displaced Jagged | .05872150 | .01174703 | 73 |
| #18 compound hole/island | .00547219 | .00298861 | 22 |
| #22 occluded circles | .00467572 | .00308837 | 8 |

[Full findings and rigorous limits](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/blob/experiment/557-distance-field-oracle-20261024/docs/RECONSTRUCTION-VTRACER-GENUINE-ART-FINDINGS-2026-10-24.md). All five source PNGs were SHA256 verified unchanged.

**Important:** VTracer traces source pixels; its SVG paths are not equivalent editable procedural ROYGBIV recipes. Loop has 107 SVG path fragments, so no wholesale integration is justified. The EDT oracle passes exact brute-force tests but is not yet connected to actual per-hue source masks; coordinate that integration with Agent 1. No production renderer, creative defaults, output schemas, private data, or Android performance claims were changed. Physical Pixel, TalkBack, owner creative acceptance and native app memory/thermal remain untested.

sources.title: Reconstruction #557: reusable pinned VTracer offline oracle with six genuine image benchmarks
sources.description:
## Completed genuine-source VTracer experiment: reusable offline comparator, no new PWA dependency

I pinned the **official VTracer release 1.0.0-alpha.4 Linux MUSL binary** to SHA-256 `2058f611b48ed49497f78883bde47435531e9e17e3a79428432d1528bdb12e2a` and independently verified the downloaded archive before execution. In [one-shot actual production-Chromium R0 #40167184750](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40167184750), the signed-off product renderer generated six **genuine 480×1040** ROYGBIV source PNGs; metadata-free IDAT-preserving copies were given to VTracer, which produced SVGs. The SVGs were rasterized at the original 480×1040 with CairoSVG and the **actual source/vector PNG pairs directly opened and reviewed**.

| Genuine source | SVG paths | SVG bytes | Normalized RGB MAE of SVG raster | Bright-foreground IoU |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| #04 Jagged | 13 | 29,100 | .006866 | .98194 |
| #05 Hairpin | 17 | 30,331 | .012025 | .95870 |
| #06 Loop | **107** | 45,231 | .013846 | .97165 |
| #16 displaced Jagged | **73** | 36,534 | .007453 | .97913 |
| #18 compound holes/islands | 22 | 4,827 | **.001256** | .96736 |
| #22 reversed overlapping circles | 8 | 6,688 | .002239 | **.99148** |

These are exact current source/SVG-back-to-PNG comparisons (not the product's lower-resolution canonical reconstruction error or source-seed proof). CLI alone took ~.03–.16s per case (installation and SVG rasterization excluded). Although vectorized images look convincingly close, Loop's **107 path objects** and displaced Jagged's **73** demonstrate an editability/complexity trap. **Decision: keep VTracer as an offline visual upper-bound oracle, NOT a new browser/worker inverse renderer or current canonical recipe engine.**

### Deliverables
- Reusable standalone `scripts/benchmark-reconstruction-vtracer.py`: invoke a trusted external CLI or compare trusted previously captured SVGs; read-only bounded 1–50 source PNGs (≤650k pixels), source/SVG SHA256, native-size vector-raster PNGs, RGB/bright-ink metrics, SVG path/size counts. Reject external SVG refs/DTD/embedded images and missing sources.
- Separate optional pinned `docs/reconstruction-vtracer-requirements.txt`: NumPy/Pillow/CairoSVG. **No new app JavaScript, npm, default CI, importer/recipe/renderer, external model download or production inference change.**
- Four deterministic independent Python tests: exact source-to-SVG reconstruction, no source file mutation, disallow unsafe SVG dependency, fail closed on missing/invalid inputs. **[Optional GitHub Python test #40167542177 green](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40167542177).**
- [Detailed genuine optical findings and reproduction](docs/RECONSTRUCTION-VTRACER-ACTUAL-ORACLE-2026-10-25.md), including verified release digest, command and source-specific complexity outcomes.

Temporary heavyweight Chromium and Python acceptance workflows were **both removed** after their evidence runs. Normal [GitHub quick check #40167545824 green](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40167545824) on committed implementation; final cleanup head check pending. No changes to ≤6+≤10 real-paint fit budget, source preservation, canonical locks/Undo/provenance/export, typography or mobile UX. No physical Pixel, external owner artwork or creative human acceptance asserted. #557 stays open for Hairpin black gaps, Loop crossing topology, arbitrary pigment occlusion. Ready for Agent 3 independent final integration.

sources.title: Reconstruction #557: source-visible seven-hue canonical shape candidate, all 22 R0 accepted
sources.description:
## Production #557: one source-visible seven-hue candidate INSIDE six real painter calls

This PR bridges the existing shared seven-colour importer to canonical independent shape snapshots merged in #709, retaining the normal image→editable-recipe chooser, existing `drawWallpaper`, worker/Undo/recipe transport and original source bytes. Each pigment is a source-visible, individually editable compound geometry with measured centre/radius, holes and islands. No hidden source geometry, seed, painter order, bitmap overlay or new runtime dependency is claimed.

### Verified actual source fidelity

[Full genuine 22-case Chromium R0 run #40220074924](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40220074924) **passed** explicit fidelity and control-preservation acceptance. R0 current selected scores: Hairpin #05 `.08447791 → .03053935` (63.85% lower error), Loop #06 `.04977317 → .03783583` (23.98% lower), displaced Jagged #16 `.05872150 → .01330855` (77.34% lower), ordinary Jagged #04 `.01862755`, Wave #03 `.01365135`, Draw #07 `.02354522`, diagonal straight #02 `.01555587`. Native circle/compound controls #11/#17/#18/#20/#22 all retain their previous superior kinds/scores; radial/partial-hue/Jewel cases retain their fallbacks. An independently downloaded **15-case original/current/new PNG atlas** was viewed directly. Source-derived native **3024×6552 portable recipe PNGs** for #05/#06/#16 succeeded.

An earlier integration draft failed the existing test protecting **all three measured diagonal hypotheses**; that was repaired. Production candidate selection still offers three diagonal angles, Jagged and a safe Draw, or preserves the safe/wide Draw pair on non-diagonal wave cases. Rank and cooperative rank always draw **at most six initial plus ten refinement** ordinary painter outputs. A separately-labelled `--hue-visible-shapes` R0 research comparison uses one extra painter, **never part of normal UX**.

### Truthfulness, bounds and integration

Uses one canonical colour mask classifier and existing component flood-fill / edge loops / `normalizeCompoundRegion` with holes; per-hue geometry remains inside the 1200-vertex and 192KiB existing portable scene contract. Fail closed for non-seven-hue/unsupported shapes, incompatible locks and bad geometry. Neutralizes past textures/Photo/material and camera. PNG-origin `candidateKind` now supports explicit `hue-visible-shapes`; hidden/cropped source contours and source seed explicitly remain unknown. Source importer, worker/normal rendering, full-res export, JSON and Undo ownership are unchanged.

Fast unit tests and GHA artifact evidence are green; **heavy 22-art PR trigger removed after optical review**, manual-only workflow retained. No physical Android/Pixel, TalkBack, owner human signoff or exact procedural seed recovery claimed. The complete [22-case findings and limitations](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/blob/experiment/557-source-hue-compound-extraction-20261025/docs/RECONSTRUCTION-HUE-VISIBLE-SOURCE-R0-FINDINGS-2026-10-25.md) and authoritative queue updated. Keep #557 OPEN for better Loop fragment grouping, truly mixed pigment occlusion and independent physical acceptance.

sources.title: Reconstruction #557: restore 13/11/9 source-visible Loop islands, all 22 R0 accepted
sources.description:
## #557: recover observed Loop fragment islands without weakening legacy extraction

Current source-visible per-hue reconstruction (#710) initially inherited the general-purpose source component truncation at eight islands per hue. Actual native Loop #06 source masks include **13 red, 11 orange and 9 yellow significant visible components**, so the candidate was silently omitting real coloured details around crossings.

This patch makes `components()` accept a bounded optional result limit while **every preexisting caller still defaults to eight**. Only `extractVisibleHueCompound` requests 16 plus one overflow sentinel; a 17th substantial island **refuses** the appearance hypothesis instead of claiming all visible pigment was captured. Uses the existing HSV masks, flood fill, edge walks, hole validator, 1200-vertex and 192KiB per-recipe limits; does not modify normal renderer, model, path import, player locks, Undo, worker, provenance or ≤6+10 real painter budget.

### True Chromium/source proof

[Full 22 genuine metadata-free R0 run #40220797778](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40220797778) passed with ten focused tests, all previous source/fit acceptance gates and real 3024×6552 Loop PNG export. Loop source-backed component counts are now **[13,11,9,7,5,3,1]** (previously **[8,8,8,7,5,3,1]**). Its normal current-renderer error improved **0.037835831448 → 0.037259517188** (1.52% further reduction), with the **other 21 source cases numerically unchanged**. This change makes the total prior procedural Loop error .049773166478 fall to .037259517188, a 25.14% reduction.

Downloaded genuine old/current PNGs and opened a three-panel matched-scale comparison. Extra small source-visible fragments near ring intersections are restored, without spurious large hue patches, distorted centre hole or new visual regressions. [Detailed optical and numerical findings](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/blob/experiment/557-visible-loop-fragment-coverage-20261025/docs/RECONSTRUCTION-LOOP-VISIBLE-ISLANDS-FINDINGS-2026-10-25.md).

Targeted normal PR quick gate succeeded; the temporary expensive optical proof trigger was removed after independent image inspection, leaving **manual-only** GHA. No invisible original topology/seed, physical Pixel/IME/TalkBack or creator approval claims. #557 remains open for future well-grounded contour simplification and actual-device tests.

sources.title: Reconstruction #557: measured Jewel palette restores source-visible colour, all 22 R0 accepted
sources.description:
## Proven source palette defect and code change

The existing `measuredCanonicalPalette` descriptor already provides a conservative source-only Jewel/Classic appearance hint to every other candidate. The newer seven-visible-compound-hue candidate from #710/#711 accidentally overrode that hint with hardcoded Classic, forcing correct visible source geometry to paint the wrong colours. This PR shares **the same high-confidence descriptor** with `observedHueShapeRecipe`. Ambiguous source stays Classic. No new classifier, source truth, historical seed, hidden painter order, data schema, worker runtime dependency or default paint.

The offline research-only `--hue-visible-shapes` comparison now passes the same measured colour story as the normal chooser. Previously it could misleadingly preview neon Classic while production had selected Jewel. Palette lock projection remains authoritative, geometry is identical under palette changes, and candidate search remains **≤6 initial `drawWallpaper` paints +≤10 refinement**. New unit tests cover explicit Jewel story, unknown fallback, exact contour preservation and user lock.

## Real image evidence

All-22 source-blind, genuine current-renderer Chromium evaluation: [#40222117789](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40222117789) native improvement, [#40222298069](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40222298069) corrected research comparator, [#40222314108](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/actions/runs/40222314108) explicit #19 ≤.016 error and full control gate, **all success**. Jewel #19 native previous `.025285947712` → proposed `.015307629462` (**39.46% lower RGB/brightness error**). The other **21 of 22** R0 native best kinds and error values are completely unchanged: Hairpin `.03053935`, Loop `.03725952`, Jagged `.01330855`, all native circle/compound/radial/incomplete-pigment controls.

Source, previous fit, new Jewel-aware fit and original incorrectly Classic-coloured research preview were extracted from real separately uploaded GHA source/fit archives and **directly visually inspected at matching size**. The rich darker pigments and visible source boundaries are much more faithful in the new native fit; no crop/hidden contour is inferred.

Verified source-optical [findings and user-facing limitations](https://github.com/gamesbyian/wallgen/blob/experiment/557-observed-hue-palette-measurement-20261025/docs/RECONSTRUCTION-SOURCE-PALETTE-REUSE-FINDINGS-2026-10-25.md), up-to-date authoritative work queue and parent inverse vision plan. Heavy one-shot GHA hook removed after acceptance, `workflow_dispatch` manual-only again; small quick CI remains. No physical Pixel owner acceptance claimed. Issue #557 remains open for complex external pigments and contour refinement.

sources.title: research(#557): source-blind independent seven-pigment shape acceptance
sources.description:
## Evidence first; no product inference code changed yet
Investigate a candidate-routing blind spot: seven compact source colour regions are presumed to be circles even when their actual visible silhouettes are triangles, polygons or concave stars. Independently author four **Canvas2D** sources (seven mixed polygons, seven concave stars, seven round discs as a negative control, and seven visibly overlapping coloured shapes). These are generated without `drawWallpaper`, without a ROYGBIV recipe/seed, with no external third-party art. Their manifest is explicitly `roygbiv-reconstruction-external/v1` and source-byte metadata extraction must return null.

A deliberately temporary one-shot PR optical workflow uses the existing real Chromium R0 evaluator: exactly <=6+10 true production painter calls for normal chosen candidate and **separate research-only** one-paint `observedHueShapeRecipe` comparator. Records source/fit/research PNGs and truthful numerical errors for all four. No algorithm change is authorized until actual rendered evidence demonstrates a real deficit and protected circular/radial cases can be retained. Temporary PR-triggered heavy job must be removed before any accepted merge. #557 stays open; other agents own typography and mobile.

sources.title: fix(#557): allow observed compact polygons while preserving measured circles
sources.description:
## Source-backed candidate-selection defect
Independent Canvas-authored metadata-free seven-pigment polygons from draft #722 are ranked as seven circles (real painter error 0.046984685), while the existing seven editable source-visible compound ring adapter separately paints the real polygons at 0.035807292. A round-disk negative control correctly prefers the circle recipe (0.036686247 vs observed 0.037595741). Do not sacrifice the established circles model.

## Narrow source-evidence rule
The single existing source importer already fits seven exposed circular background arcs as `circleHints` with stringent residual and coverage bounds. If seven compact pigment blobs are present **without all seven valid circle fits**, offer the already normalized, portable, source-only per-hue compound candidate alongside circles in the same six-paint budget. Preserve the historical path for all seven actual measured disks. All usual source coverage, holes/islands, shape topology caps, locks/Undo/source/provenance/worker restrictions remain unchanged. No classifier or renderer added.

## Next acceptance
The targeted pixel-authored seven-triangle vs seven-circle test is included. Await corrected external independent concave-star fixture acceptance in #722, then run normal full 22 genuine Chromium cases plus four standalone external controls with source/fitted actual PNG inspection and no more than six initial / ten refinement paints. Do not merge until there are no demonstrated regressions. Issue #557 remains open.
